feeds.title: FrenchEntrée
feeds.description: FrenchEntrée is your complete online guide to buying French Property and Living in France. With nearly 20 years of experience and a network of trusted partners and experts, our site has grown to become an invaluable source of advice and inspiration to hundreds of thousands of readers looking to buy, live, or enjoy a holiday in la belle France.

feeds.title: Oui In France
feeds.description: I'm Diane and my blog Oui In France launched in May 2012! Well, I'm an American living in western France with my French husband, Tom, and sweet Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Dagny. I'm dog obsessed, fitness enthusiast, travel lover and Francophile to start off. Follow my blog as majority of my posts will have something to do with France the French language, French culture & what it's like living abroad.

feeds.title: Thyme for Cooking Blog
feeds.description: It's about the food, recipes, insights and about life in France. Follow this blog to get articles on French life.

feeds.title: This Is Lyon
feeds.description: ThisisLyon.fr - All about Lyon France. Discover the best of Lyon: things to do, places to visit, accommodation, insider tips... Follow This Is Lyon and get ideas and tips on best things to do in France.

feeds.title: Curious Provence
feeds.description: Curious Provence is a blog created for Photographer in Provence. It has all kinds of information about life in Provence, what to do and see as well as lots of photos of the region.

feeds.title: Life in Rural France
feeds.description: If you're looking to move to rural France, you're in the right place. We share the best French locations, places to eat and hidden gems. Find out more about living in rural France in the Charente region - all the laughter & tears.

feeds.title: The Knowledge Nuggets
feeds.description: Hello!!! I'm Katherine and the creator of The Knowledge Nuggets. In my blog, I will share my wisdom and insights on moving to Paris, along with loads of fun facts and resources on parenting, travel, and other topics for all you awesome parents out there.

feeds.title: Living the life in Saint-Aignan
feeds.description: Day by day in France's Loire Valley. I'm an American from North Carolina who lives in France. I speak French and love French cooking, history, and language — not to mention life in the Touraine wine country. My husband Walt and I have been together for 30 years — the last 12 of those in the Loire Valley.

feeds.title: Américaine in France
feeds.description: Covers language learning tips, insight into life abroad & French bureaucracy, and travel advice for Paris and beyond.

feeds.title: Life on La Lune
feeds.description: A British writer's life in southwest France. Come with me on a journey through French life. In 1997, we sold up in the UK and started a new adventure in Southwest France in an 18th-century farmhouse amid glorious countryside. Life on La Lune includes episodes from our French life, snippets about French history, culture and customs, and details of things happening in our area.

feeds.title: Brittany and Loire Blog
feeds.description: For English residents living in France. Francophile with French holiday home. This is a website was originally dedicated to a little town in Brittany called La Roche Bernard, and its immediate surrounding area. Events have conspired to expand the geographical sphere of interest to the whole of Brittany and the Pays de la Loire regions of France.

feeds.title: Days on the Claise
feeds.description: The daily diary of two Australians living in the Loire Valley. Follow to get details of our private guided tours of chateaux, wineries, markets and more

feeds.title: FranceSays
feeds.description: Observations of life in France. By an adopted Française. It's been twenty-five years since I moved to France, armed with little more than a rudimentary grasp of the language and an unabashed love of its food and wine. Oh, and my husband, who is French, although he was a happy expat and would willingly have lived his whole life away from la patrie.

feeds.title: La Ramoneta
feeds.description: In 2012 my husband, our three children and I moved from downtown Amsterdam to a lovely village in the South of France, where we still live with great pleasure. Before we moved here, we didn't know the region very well. Since then, we have seen and done so much here. We have found many wonderful places. And still discovering new ones, there's so much to do! So the idea of this blog arose: to share our journey through the Languedoc region for anyone interested in this great part of France.

feeds.title: Mois French Adventure
feeds.description: Living life as if someone left the gate open! Taking the chance and seeing what happens. At 52 years old I took the plunge, and sold my beautiful Edwardian house in Herne Bay to fulfil my dream of living in France. So this blog is for you Joyce and Paddy, and for all the people who are thinking of making the change, getting off that road and taking one of the paths to who knows where.

feeds.title: Expat in France Blog
feeds.description: I am Guillemette alias Mademoiselle Guiga, a French serial expat and expatriation management professional. With this blog, I want to help expats coming to France to sort out their French administration processes and also understand French culture. Insider tips from a French expat to English speaking expats in France! Welcome to my new blog!

feeds.title: The Healthy Epicurean
feeds.description: The food I usually prepare is probably best described as a healthy, spiced-up take on traditional French fare. As I seem to spend much of my time either making it, eating it, or clearing it up, I thought that I might as well blog about it as well. Anecdotes and healthy eating ideas for delicious, food with a French twist.

feeds.title: Manger
feeds.description: It has been and continues to be such an amazing ride, I was fortunate enough to be asked to host a cooking show here in France on Cuisine based on the blog and one of my childhood dreams came true when I wrote a cookbook called A kitchen in France. Follow my blog to get various articles on France and French Cuisine.

feeds.title: French Moments
feeds.description: French Moments is passionate about promoting the French language and culture through its website, lessons and Paris walking tours. Explore Paris and France in a new way with the French Moments team through thousands of articles, photos, videos, quizzes and more.

feeds.title: Taste of France
feeds.description: The beautiful life in the other South of France. Belgian-American love affair with France. French food. French wine. French décor. French culture. French history. French countryside. We want to give francophiles and travel fans a taste of life in France. Follow this blog and get to know all about living in France. We hope you'll visit!

feeds.title: Our French Oasis - LIVING A FRENCH COUNTRY LIFE
feeds.description: Living a country life in France with far too many children, cats, dogs and chickens! Our life through the seasons, our love of good home cooked food, gardening, and anything that inspires us - a beautiful view, a long walk in the wind and rain in winter, living outdoors in the summer, stunning French interiors....using only my own photos. Follow my blog to read my posts on living and life in France.

feeds.title: Chez Loulou
feeds.description: This blog includes stories about the delicious regional food and wine from around France, European travel insights and experiences, recipes of my favorite sweet and savory dishes, photos of the stunning scenery and charming vignettes I capture through my camera lens, stories of life in France, including the ever-present challenge of French bureaucracy and practical advice about moving to France. Follow my blog as I share posts on taste of life in France.

feeds.title: Annie: The Live in France Guide
feeds.description: Expat travel & lifestyle blog featuring, destination guides, inspiration, travel tips and advice on working, living and playing in France. Follow this blog to get expat guide on living in France.

feeds.title: At home in Correze
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from At home in Correze.

feeds.title: Manny's Blog
feeds.description: Mum, wife, actress, singer, film producer, publisher...blogger...Living in France

feeds.title: Living well for less in France
feeds.description: A blog about simple frugal living in a French village to get the most out of life. We are Kevin and Heather Hay. We are 50 something early retirees living in the Charente region of France. We are aiming to live as well as we can as cheaply as we can. We will do this by growing our own food, foraging, swapping foods, goods and services. We also try to save on the essentials to pay for the luxuries.

feeds.title: A Small Village in France
feeds.description: A Small Village in France. Who we are is Tom and Susan Vieth. After 22 years of loving Vermont and having tremendous success with Tom's art career we are making a new bold move - we are now living in Bourdeilles,France.

feeds.title: Our French Life
feeds.description: OUR FRENCH LIFE. The everyday ramblings of a francophile. A blog on a retired couple living the dream in France and renovating an old French house, no building skills just materials, and eating what we grow

feeds.title: Fresh French
feeds.description: I'm Abigail, dedicated expat and native French teacher, enchantée. Fresh French is all about helping you settle down faster in France and learning French the fearless way. Learning French as an expat in France. Finally, here I am, slowly making my way through Europe while creating this online guide on living in France and learnin﻿g French the fearless way.

feeds.title: Aussie in France
feeds.description: Living in France: Insights into the French way of life by an Australian living in Paris. Love reading, writing, travelling, wine, cycling & mushrooms. Gîte in Loire Valley. Loire Daily Photo. I love sharing my experiences of living in France and showing friends and family the things I like best.

feeds.title: * Tongue in Cheek *
feeds.description: Stories collected while living in France. Thirty years living in France because I married a Frenchman that I met while dancing in San Francisco° Two children, now in their mid-twenties, amour et joie° I have the 'Brocante Bug' which means antiquing is my cure, France can do me no wrong when it comes to treatment. Follow my blog as I share my stories of living in France.

feeds.title: Blog in France
feeds.description: A blog about the fun and frustrations of expat life in France. Hello, I'm Stephanie and yes, I'm a lady with llamas!
